verdict.rationale: Ramp's docs show automatic receipt capture with AI-filled memos/categories (ramp-docs-8, ramp-docs-32), OCR line-item accuracy (ramp-docs-16), fraud flagging and expense coding via 'infinite teammates' AI (ramp-docs-21), duplicate/missing-item detection via MCP prompts (ramp-docs-29), and policy/match-based auditing (ramp-docs-17, ramp-docs-25, ramp-docs-9). This covers reading receipts, categorization/memo suggestion, and fraud/duplicate catching across first-party marketing and support docs. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of accuracy claims and explicit named 'duplicate detection' feature documentation beyond marketing copy.
